label: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.7 a.1 co., 'infinitum dicitur aliquid ex eo quod non est finitum'…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.7 a.1 co., 'infinitum dicitur aliquid ex eo quod non est finitum', in the direction converse to STMT-UNLIMITED-ESSE-IS-INFINITE: for every being x, if x is infinite (the primitive Infinite, infinity of perfection simpliciter), then the esse of x is not limited. Q.7 a.2 co. calls subsistent created forms and prime matter infinite only secundum quid; they are not Infinite in this sense.
